products.name: Adobe Express (the enterprise plan is called Adobe Express for Enterprise in Adobe's help)

what.text: Adobe's web and mobile app for making images, videos, social posts and flyers from templates; the enterprise plan adds roles, brand controls, shared templates and approval workflows.
what.quote: Create and edit your images and videos for social posts, flyers, logos, and more.

status_source.quote: System Admins and Product Admins set up and manage Adobe Express roles and permissions through Admin Console

connections.how: AEM Assets opens inside Express through Content Advisor, so users place approved assets on the Express canvas and save new or edited files back to AEM Assets; the AEM Assets view and Content Hub also embed the Express editor.
connections.quote: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets integrates natively with Adobe Express, allowing you to discover, access, and use assets from AEM Assets directly within the Express interface using Content Advisor.

connections.how: A designer attaches a Workfront approval workflow to an Express template; files remixed from it must be approved in Workfront before they can be published.
connections.quote: After an approval workflow template is created in Workfront, designers with an Express Enterprise premium license can assign it to an Express template directly within Adobe Express.

connections.how: Where Workfront uses unified approvals, the Express template review runs in the Frame.io viewer; the connection goes through Workfront, not Express to Frame.io directly.
connections.quote: Conduct for deep reviews using drawing markups, annotations, and commenting with the Frame.io viewer

connections.how: Edit in Adobe Express in the Email Designer opens Express tools on an image (resize, remove background, crop, convert); an Express Enterprise license opens the full editor.
connections.quote: The Adobe Express integration in Adobe Journey Optimizer allows you to easily access Adobe Express’s powerful editing tools while creating content.

connections.how: Edit in Adobe Express on an image in Design Studio opens Express editing tools; users with an Express Enterprise license in the same IMS org get the full editor.
connections.quote: Adobe Marketo Engage integrates natively with Adobe Express, giving you access to a variety of image editing tools.

connections.how: Images in the Journey Optimizer B2B Edition asset repository open in Express editing tools; the entitlement is included with the subscription.
connections.quote: Adobe Journey Optimizer B2B Edition integrates natively with Adobe Express, and enables you to access a set of Adobe Express image editing tools.

connections.how: Templates designed in Express (same IMS org) appear in GenStudio Create for Meta, Display, LinkedIn and TikTok, with their lock settings; image assets and generated variants can be edited in an embedded Express canvas.
connections.quote: GenStudio for Performance Marketing can use templates that have been created and designed in Adobe Express.

connections.how: Generate Variations in AEM Sites hands a copy variation to Express Text to Image and takes the chosen image back; it needs an Express entitlement in the IMS org.
connections.quote: After you have generated text variations, you can generate images in Adobe Express using the Generative AI capabilities of Firefly.

connections.how: A Commerce as a Cloud Service use case walks through opening a product image from AEM Assets in Express, changing it, and seeing it on the storefront. The link is AEM Assets; there is no direct Commerce to Express connector.
connections.quote: The combination of Adobe Commerce, AEM Assets, and Adobe Express allows you to complete this change in a few steps.

connections.how: The Express editor generates content with Firefly; Adobe documents this where Express is embedded in other products.
connections.quote: With an Enterprise license, users have full access to the Adobe Express Web editor, enabling them to adjust asset settings, generate content with Firefly, add text, and apply additional customizations.

connections.how: A trained custom model can be picked when generating images in Express.
connections.quote: Custom models can be used to generate content in supported Adobe apps, including Photoshop, Illustrator, Adobe Express, Firefly, and GenStudio.

connections.how: Photoshop and Illustrator files are added to an Express design as linked images that stay in sync, or converted into editable Express files.
connections.quote: There are two ways to incorporate Photoshop and Illustrator files into your Adobe Express designs.

connections.how: The Adobe Express API sits in the Firefly Services developer documentation: it reads tagged Express documents, generates variations and exports renditions. Adobe labels it beta and access is by request.
connections.quote: The Adobe Express API provides an effortless way to incorporate Adobe Express functionalities into your applications through a straightforward REST-based API.

products.name: Frame.io (Adobe's product description lists the plans Frame.io Enterprise: Select and Frame.io Enterprise: Prime)

what.text: A cloud workspace where creative teams and their stakeholders upload, organize, review and approve work-in-progress assets, video above all.
what.quote: Frame.io empowers creative teams and their stakeholders to organize, review and manage creative assets as they move from ideation to final approval, and orchestrate the people and processes supporting them.

status_source.quote: To use the endpoints described here, you must first have a provisioned Frame.io V4 account administered via the Adobe Admin Console.

connections.how: Unified review and approval: work is managed in Workfront and reviewed and approved in the Frame.io viewer, on shared Adobe cloud storage. The viewer is included for Workfront users; it replaces Workfront Proof once enabled.
connections.quote: Project coordinators manage work in Workfront while creatives, marketers, and stakeholders review and approve assets in the professional-grade Frame.io viewer, all without moving files between disconnected tools.

connections.how: Assets that finished review in Workfront with Frame.io are pushed with their metadata to AEM Assets as a Cloud Service; the integration is set up in Workfront and needs Adobe cloud storage.
connections.quote: This integration allows you to leverage the capabilities of Adobe Experience Manager, Frame.io, and Workfront to streamline your content management and collaboration processes.

connections.how: Frame.io tools sit inside Premiere Pro, and Frame.io shares Adobe cloud storage with Creative Cloud apps. For enterprise Creative Cloud customers Frame.io is off until the admin turns it on in the Admin Console.
connections.quote: Adobe Creative Cloud for teams and enterprise users can access Frame.io tools within Adobe Premiere Pro, as well as the Frame.io web, Apple iPad, and Apple iPhone apps.

connections.how: Express templates sent for approval through Workfront are reviewed in the Frame.io viewer; the connection goes through Workfront.
connections.quote: Conduct for deep reviews using drawing markups, annotations, and commenting with the Frame.io viewer

connections.how: Workflow input and output nodes can read from and write to Frame.io as a cloud source, where the organization has it configured.
connections.quote: Supported cloud sources commonly include Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) Assets and other Adobe cloud storage integrations, which let you pull content from services such as Adobe Cloud Storage and Frame.io when available in your environment.

connections.how: The Substance 3D API in Firefly Services accepts a Frame.io folder as the source of files for a job.
connections.quote: Upload assets from your server, a public URL, or Frame.io, submit jobs asynchronously, and retrieve high-quality images at scale.
